name: How long does it take to repair a main line backup?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to repair a main line backup?

acceptedAnswer.text: The time required for main line backup repair depends on the complexity of the issue. Simple blockages cleared by hydro-jetting can often be resolved within a few hours. More complex repairs involving pipe replacement due to severe damage or root intrusion may take longer, potentially requiring a full day or multiple days, especially if excavation is necessary. We aim to complete repairs efficiently while ensuring a lasting solution, and we'll provide an estimated timeframe after our initial assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair time varies; simple clogs might take hours, while complex pipe replacements can take a day or more.
